# Seattle Housing Authority

> > Seattle Housing Authority provides affordable housing resources, resident services, and community development programs for Seattle residents.

The Seattle Housing Authority serves low-income families, seniors, and individuals by offering public housing, rental assistance programs, and supportive services. Through partnerships with organizations like The Seattle Public Library, SHA provides residents with access to educational resources, business development workshops, and community enrichment opportunities.

## Key Topics

- affordable housing
- public housing
- rental assistance
- resident services
- community development
- business workshops
- entrepreneurship
- small business support
- nonprofit events
- library services
- The Seattle Public Library
- housing programs
- tenant resources
- community partnerships

- [Business & Nonprofit Calendar | The Seattle Public Library](http://www.seattlehousing.org/news/attend-free-business-classes): Free business classes and workshops via Seattle Public Library partnership
